summary: For the direct-job example, change the job template and inventory names, optionally set owners to the Red Hat image ID, optionally set wait_for_completion true (with wait_for_completion_timeout_seconds) so Terraform waits for the job's final state, then commit and run terraform plan and apply.
questions: How do I make Terraform wait for the AAP job to finish?
What does wait_for_completion do in aap_job_launch?
What must I change in the TF Actions direct job example?
